reference_findings.diagnosis: Coronary embolism is a differential mechanism; require assessment for alternative plaque event and potential embolic source.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: High concern / mechanism-specific; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: Transient inferolateral ST-T changes; rhythm strip shows atrial fibrillation.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: Serial hs-cTn rises above fictional threshold; CBC, renal function, coagulation-related history and bleeding assessment are required.
investigation_reports.echocardiography: LVEF 50%; mild inferolateral hypokinesis. Left atrial appendage source is not established by this transthoracic study.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiography: abrupt distal obtuse marginal branch cut-off with little diffuse coronary plaque elsewhere; initial angiogram cannot prove embolic source. TIMI 0 distal branch in initial synthetic image.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 96 bpm irregular; BP 120/74 mmHg; RR 18/min; SpO2 97%; stable.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.chief_complaint: Acute chest discomfort with transient ischemic ECG changes and troponin rise.
history.history_of_present_illness: History includes atrial fibrillation and recent interruption of prescribed anticoagulation in the fictional scenario; this is a clue requiring verification, not proof of embolism.
relevant_history: Prior transient ischemic attack in fictional history
medication_reconciliation: Anticoagulation history incomplete; last dose, indication, interruptions and bleeding history must be clarified

pathway_review.label: Specialist assessment of coronary mechanism and potential embolic source
pathway_review.reason: Atrial fibrillation history and abrupt branch cut-off support investigation but are not conclusive.

pathway_review.label: Assume embolism solely because atrial fibrillation is present
pathway_review.reason: Risk factor does not establish mechanism.

pathway_review.label: Ignore anticoagulation history and bleeding risk
pathway_review.reason: Medication and bleeding history are central safety variables.

reference_findings.safety_review: Reconcile anticoagulant and antiplatelet history, last dose, adherence, renal function, bleeding history and allergy status; do not give dose-specific advice in the simulator.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: source evaluation remains part of debrief; learner is scored on considering embolic mechanism without prematurely closing the differential.
learning_objectives: Identify clues to embolic coronary occlusion.
Treat anticoagulant history and bleeding assessment as essential.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
